item.title: Spurs pick up rare Stamford Bridge win as Palmer sent off
item.description:
⚽ Tottenham picked up just their second victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in 36 years with a 2-0 victory, as the host finished with 10-men after a record card for Cole Palmer.

item.title: 'Best performance since I arrived' - De Zerbi praises Spurs after win
item.description:
⚽ Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi describes his side's 2-0 victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge as "the best since he arrived at the club", adding the win was special given it was against their local rivals.

item.description:
